reviews.review: This is not a good game at all. The graphics are descent but the game suffers from constant frame rate drops no matter what graphic settings. The gameplay gets repetitive and it is very shallow with go to this spot and press the action key then go to the next spot and press the action key. You are also timed when trying to leave and if you don't make it in time the mission ends in failure. There is also no way to pause or save the game so you have to play an entire level at a time. Every level looks the same too, just some dull deserts and war torn fields. You constantly run out of ammo for your primary weapon and have to resort to a pistol and the number of enemies gets excessive after the first few levels. There is also no difference at all in easy and normal difficulty. Overall, I did not enjoy my experience with this game and I do not feel that this game is anywhere near ready.
reviews.developer_response: We appreciate your feedback! As an Early Access, we are still working hard to improve the game and have taken your suggestions into consideration. A new update is in the works that may address some of the issues you described and we hope that you try ZCrew again once the patch is released. Thanks!
